name: Florence mints the gold florin
summary: The commune of Florence issues its first gold coin, the fiorino d'oro, 3.5 g of pure gold bearing the lily of Florence and the standing John the Baptist. The florin is the first widely circulating gold coinage struck in Western Europe since Carolingian times.

_quarry.structural_significance: Re-introduces a stable European gold standard after six centuries; the florin and the Venetian ducat (1284) become the reserve currencies of Mediterranean trade and the late-medieval European banking system.
